title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 11 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Corinthians chapter 11 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 11 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Corinthians Chapter 11.

questions.question: In 1 Corinthians 11, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head
For if the woman be not covered
questions.explanation: The phrase 'Be ye followers of me' is the first statement in the chapter, found in 1 Corinthians 11:1.

questions.question: What does Paul praise the brethren for in 1 Corinthians 11?
questions.explanation: Paul praises the brethren for remembering him and keeping the ordinances as he delivered them, as stated in 1 Corinthians 11:2.

questions.question: Who is the head of every man according to 1 Corinthians 11?
questions.explanation: The verse clearly states that the head of every man is Christ, as seen in 1 Corinthians 11:3.

questions.question: What happens if a man prays or prophesies with his head covered?
questions.explanation: The text states that every man praying or prophesying with his head covered dishonors his head, as stated in 1 Corinthians 11:4.

questions.question: What does a woman do if she prays or prophesies with her head uncovered?
questions.explanation: The verse indicates that a woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head, as mentioned in 1 Corinthians 11:5.

questions.question: What should a woman do if she is not covered according to 1 Corinthians 11?
questions.explanation: The verse states that if the woman be not covered, she should also be shorn, as stated in 1 Corinthians 11:6.

questions.question: What is the relationship between man and woman in terms of creation?
options: The man is created for the woman
The woman is created for the man
The woman is of the man
questions.correctAnswer: The woman is created for the man
questions.explanation: The verse explicitly states that neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man, as found in 1 Corinthians 11:9.

questions.question: According to 1 Corinthians 11, who has power on her head because of the angels?
questions.explanation: The text states that for this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels, as per 1 Corinthians 11:10.

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 11:11 say about the relationship between man and woman in the Lord?
options: The man is without the woman
The woman is without the man
Neither is the man without the woman
questions.correctAnswer: Neither is the man without the woman
questions.explanation: The verse indicates that neither is the man without the woman, nor the woman without the man, in the Lord, as stated in 1 Corinthians 11:11.

questions.question: How is the man described in relation to the woman in 1 Corinthians 11?
options: The man is the glory of the woman
The man is the image and glory of God
The woman is the glory of God
The man is subordinate to the woman
questions.correctAnswer: The man is the image and glory of God
questions.explanation: The text clearly states that the man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God, as noted in 1 Corinthians 11:7.

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 11:12 indicate about the origin of man and woman?
options: The man is of the woman
The woman is of the man
questions.explanation: The verse indicates that the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God, as stated in 1 Corinthians 11:12.

questions.question: Is it true that the head of the woman is the man?
questions.explanation: The verse states that the head of the woman is the man, as found in 1 Corinthians 11:3.

questions.question: Is it true that the man is the glory of the woman?
questions.explanation: The verse states that the woman is the glory of the man, indicating the opposite relationship, as stated in 1 Corinthians 11:7.

questions.question: Is it false that a man should cover his head while praying according to 1 Corinthians 11?
questions.explanation: The text states that a man ought not to cover his head, indicating that it is not false, as found in 1 Corinthians 11:7.

questions.question: Is it false that a woman was created first according to 1 Corinthians 11?
questions.explanation: The text indicates that the woman is of the man, and the man was not created for the woman, suggesting the opposite of her being created first, as stated in 1 Corinthians 11:8-9.

medium.title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 11 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Corinthians Chapter 11 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Is it comely for a woman to pray unto God uncovered?
questions.explanation: The verse states that it is not comely for a woman to pray uncovered (1 Corinthians 11:13).

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 11:15 promise will happen if a woman has long hair?
questions.explanation: The verse explains that if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her (1 Corinthians 11:15).

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 11:21 say about how people behave when eating?
questions.explanation: The verse describes the division in behavior during eating, where one is hungry and another drunken (1 Corinthians 11:21).

questions.question: According to 1 Corinthians 11:18, what issue does Paul hear about when the church comes together?
questions.explanation: Paul notes that there are divisions among them when they come together (1 Corinthians 11:18).

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 11:19 indicate about heresies?
questions.explanation: The verse states that there must be heresies among them so that those who are approved may be manifest (1 Corinthians 11:19).

questions.question: In 1 Corinthians 11:20, what is Paul addressing about the Lord's supper?
options: It is not being eaten properly
It is a time of healing
It is only for the wealthy
questions.correctAnswer: It is not being eaten properly
questions.explanation: Paul indicates that their gatherings are not for the Lord's supper but are mismanaged (1 Corinthians 11:20).

questions.question: According to 1 Corinthians 11:22, what does Paul question about their behavior?
options: Their treatment of the church of God
questions.correctAnswer: Their treatment of the church of God
questions.explanation: Paul questions if they despise the church of God and shame those who don't have (1 Corinthians 11:22).

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 11:24 instruct us to do in remembrance of Jesus?
options: Take, eat: this is my body
questions.correctAnswer: Take, eat: this is my body
questions.explanation: The verse records Jesus' instruction to take and eat as a remembrance of His body (1 Corinthians 11:24).

questions.question: According to 1 Corinthians 11:1, who should we follow?
questions.explanation: Paul instructs them to be followers of him as he is of Christ (1 Corinthians 11:1).

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 11:2 praise the brethren for?
questions.explanation: Paul praises them for remembering him and keeping the ordinances he delivered (1 Corinthians 11:2).

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 11:4 say about a man praying with his head covered?
questions.explanation: The verse states that a man praying or prophesying with his head covered dishonors his head (1 Corinthians 11:4).

questions.question: According to 1 Corinthians 11:6, what should a woman do if she is not covered?
questions.explanation: The verse suggests that if a woman is not covered, she should also be shorn (1 Corinthians 11:6).

questions.question: Is it true that man is the image and glory of God according to 1 Corinthians 11:7?
questions.explanation: The verse clearly states that the man is the image and glory of God (1 Corinthians 11:7).

questions.question: Is it true that the woman was created for the man according to 1 Corinthians 11:9?
questions.explanation: The verse confirms that neither was the man created for the woman, but the woman for the man (1 Corinthians 11:9).

questions.question: Is it true that the woman is not without the man in the Lord according to 1 Corinthians 11:11?
questions.explanation: The verse states that neither is the man without the woman, nor the woman without the man (1 Corinthians 11:11).

hard.title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 11 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Corinthians Chapter 11.

questions.question: What does Paul say should be done in remembrance of Jesus?
questions.explanation: Both the drinking of the cup and eating of the bread are done in remembrance of Jesus, as stated in 1 Corinthians 11:25 and 1 Corinthians 11:26.

questions.question: Who is guilty if one eats the bread and drinks the cup unworthily?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:27 states that whosoever eats and drinks unworthily shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord, indicating personal responsibility.

questions.question: What should a man do before eating the bread and drinking the cup?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:28 explicitly instructs that a man should examine himself before partaking of the bread and cup.

questions.question: What does Paul say is the consequence of eating and drinking unworthily?
questions.explanation: According to 1 Corinthians 11:29, eating and drinking unworthily results in damnation to oneself.

questions.question: What does Paul mean by 'many sleep' in 1 Corinthians 11:30?
options: They are in a deep prayer
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 11:30, 'sleep' is a euphemism for death, indicating the serious consequences of unworthy participation.

questions.question: What does Paul imply is the purpose of judging oneself?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:31 states that if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged, indicating self-examination prevents divine judgment.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'testament' in 1 Corinthians 11:25 mean?
questions.explanation: The Greek word translated as 'testament' in 1 Corinthians 11:25 is 'diatheke', which means 'covenant', reflecting the new covenant in Jesus' blood.

questions.question: What literary technique is present in 1 Corinthians 11:26 with the phrase 'ye do shew the Lord's death'?
questions.explanation: The phrase 'ye do shew the Lord's death' uses typology as it connects the act of communion to the sacrificial death of Christ.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of self-examination in communion?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:5 encourages believers to examine themselves to see whether they are in the faith, paralleling the self-examination in 1 Corinthians 11:28.

questions.question: Which other passage emphasizes the significance of the Lord's Supper?
questions.explanation: Luke 22:19-20 details the institution of the Lord's Supper, echoing the themes found in 1 Corinthians 11:23-25.

questions.question: What verse precedes 1 Corinthians 11:30 about being weak and sickly?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:30 follows 1 Corinthians 11:29, which discusses eating and drinking unworthily, leading to weakness and sickness.

questions.question: What is the consequence of not discerning the Lord's body according to 1 Corinthians 11:29?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:29 indicates that not discerning the Lord's body leads to damnation, emphasizing the seriousness of communion.

questions.question: The statement 'But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord' is meant to convey what theme?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:32 suggests that the judgment from the Lord serves to correct believers, not to condemn them with the world.

questions.question: It is important to wait for one another when coming together to eat. True or False?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:33 instructs the brethren to tarry one for another when they come together to eat, highlighting the importance of unity.

questions.question: Paul is indifferent about how the Corinthians conduct their gatherings. True or False?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:17 indicates that Paul is not indifferent; he expresses disapproval of their gatherings, stating they come together for the worse.

theological.title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 11 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Corinthians Chapter 11 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does 1 Corinthians 11:3 teach about God's ordering of authority in creation?
options: Christ is the head of every man, the man is the head of the woman, and God is the head of Christ
God is the head of every man and woman equally
The woman is the head of the man and Christ
Men and women have equal headship under Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Christ is the head of every man, the man is the head of the woman, and God is the head of Christ
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:3 explicitly states the order of headship: Christ over man, man over woman, and God over Christ, revealing the created order and authority structure.

questions.question: What doctrine about the Lord’s Supper and its proper observance does 1 Corinthians 11:27 teach?
options: Eating and drinking unworthily makes one guilty of the body and blood of the Lord
Anyone may partake of the Lord’s Supper without self-examination
The Lord’s Supper is a symbolic meal with no moral implications
The Lord’s Supper is only for the clergy
questions.correctAnswer: Eating and drinking unworthily makes one guilty of the body and blood of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:27 warns that unworthy participation in the Lord’s Supper results in guilt regarding Christ’s body and blood, emphasizing the necessity of self-examination.

questions.question: What doctrine about sin and divine discipline does 1 Corinthians 11:30 teach?
options: Many are weak, sickly, and have died because of unworthy participation in the Lord’s Supper
Physical illness is unrelated to spiritual sin
Sickness is purely natural and unrelated to church behavior
The church should ignore physical consequences of sin
questions.correctAnswer: Many are weak, sickly, and have died because of unworthy participation in the Lord’s Supper
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:30 connects physical weakness and death to the sin of unworthy participation, teaching that sin can bring divine chastening.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does 1 Corinthians 11:32 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:32 shows God's longsuffering by chastening believers to prevent their condemnation with the world, reflecting patience and mercy.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is demonstrated in 1 Corinthians 11:23 regarding the institution of the Lord's Supper?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:23 recounts Jesus instituting the Lord’s Supper, demonstrating God’s covenant faithfulness in providing a perpetual means of remembrance and grace.

questions.question: How does 1 Corinthians 11:17-22 connect to the broader biblical theme of church unity and holiness?
options: It exposes divisions and improper behavior to call the church to holiness and unity
It encourages factions to express their differences openly
It permits disorder as a sign of freedom in Christ
It teaches that social status should determine participation in worship
questions.correctAnswer: It exposes divisions and improper behavior to call the church to holiness and unity
questions.explanation: Verses 17-22 highlight divisiveness and selfishness during the Lord’s Supper, addressing the need for unity and sanctification consistent with biblical teaching on the church.

questions.question: In what way does 1 Corinthians 11:24-26 prepare for the New Testament emphasis on Christ’s atoning death?
options: By instituting the Lord’s Supper as a memorial of Christ’s broken body and shed blood
By focusing primarily on Old Testament sacrifices
By denying any remembrance of Jesus’ death
questions.correctAnswer: By instituting the Lord’s Supper as a memorial of Christ’s broken body and shed blood
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:24-26 institutes the Lord’s Supper to proclaim Christ’s death until He returns, connecting to New Testament theology of atonement and eschatological hope.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do 1 Corinthians 11:4 and 11:5 teach about worship practices and gender distinctions?
options: Men should pray or prophesy with uncovered heads, women with covered heads to honor their respective heads
Men and women have identical worship practices regarding head coverings
All believers must cover their heads regardless of gender
Head coverings are merely cultural and have no theological significance
questions.correctAnswer: Men should pray or prophesy with uncovered heads, women with covered heads to honor their respective heads
questions.explanation: Verses 4 and 5 teach that men dishonor their head by covering it, while women dishonor theirs by not covering, establishing gender distinctions in worship as a matter of honor.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do 1 Corinthians 11:11 and 11:12 teach about the interdependence of men and women in the Lord?
options: Neither man nor woman is independent; both are mutually interdependent in the Lord
Men are independent of women in salvation
Women are spiritually superior to men
Men and women are independent and unrelated in the church
questions.correctAnswer: Neither man nor woman is independent; both are mutually interdependent in the Lord
questions.explanation: Verses 11 and 12 emphasize mutual dependence of men and women spiritually and ontologically, affirming equality in Christ while respecting created order.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do 1 Corinthians 11:28 and 11:31 teach about self-examination and divine judgment?
options: Believers must judge themselves to avoid being judged by the Lord
Divine judgment is arbitrary and unrelated to behavior
Believers should ignore sin until the final judgment
questions.correctAnswer: Believers must judge themselves to avoid being judged by the Lord
questions.explanation: Verses 28 and 31 teach the crucial doctrine that self-examination precedes worthy participation and spares believers from harsher divine judgment.

questions.question: Skeptics claim 1 Corinthians 11:17-22 condones disorder and division in the church. What does this passage actually teach?
options: It condemns divisions and selfish behavior during the Lord’s Supper
It encourages factions to have separate worship times
It permits drunkenness as a spiritual gift
It teaches that disorder is a sign of freedom in Christ
questions.correctAnswer: It condemns divisions and selfish behavior during the Lord’s Supper
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:17-22 criticizes the Corinthian church for divisions and disorder at the Lord’s Supper, calling for unity and reverence, not tolerating chaos.

questions.question: What doctrine about gender roles in worship does 1 Corinthians 11:7 teach?
options: Man is the image and glory of God, while the woman is the glory of the man
Woman is the image of God, and man is the glory of the woman
Both man and woman are equally the image and glory of God
Gender distinctions do not affect worship practices
questions.correctAnswer: Man is the image and glory of God, while the woman is the glory of the man
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:7 explains the theological basis for head coverings by affirming man as the image and glory of God, and woman as the glory of man, establishing relational hierarchy.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is primarily demonstrated by 1 Corinthians 11:26 in its teaching on the Lord’s Supper?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:26 reflects God’s providence in preserving the Lord’s Supper as a continual proclamation of Christ’s death until His return.

questions.question: How does 1 Corinthians 11:10 connect to angelology and church order in biblical theology?
options: It teaches that women should have a symbol of authority on their heads because of the angels
It denies the existence or role of angels in worship
It says angels have no interest in church order
It teaches angels should lead the church
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches that women should have a symbol of authority on their heads because of the angels
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:10 uniquely links the practice of head coverings for women to the presence and authority of angels, reflecting heavenly attentiveness to worship order.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do 1 Corinthians 11:14 and 11:15 teach about natural order and gender distinction?
options: Nature teaches that long hair is shameful for men but glorious for women as a covering
Long hair is equally appropriate for men and women
Hair length is a purely cultural issue with no theological basis
Men should have long hair to display glory
questions.correctAnswer: Nature teaches that long hair is shameful for men but glorious for women as a covering
questions.explanation: Verses 14 and 15 appeal to nature to reinforce gender distinctions in appearance, symbolizing authority and honor in worship contexts.
